changes.text: In 2023 the company disposed of its customer engagement cloud business.
changes.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2023, the Company disposed goodwill of US$ 12.3 million in connection with its disposal of customer engagement cloud business and recognized full impairment for the remaining goodwill of US$ 31.9 million.
